data.title: Notion Style
data.tagline: Use document-like structure, quiet surfaces, and practical controls
data.description: Notion-style interfaces feel close to an editable document: clear text hierarchy, compact icons, neutral colors, and blocks that can be arranged. It works well for knowledge and productivity tools, but copying the appearance without the underlying content model produces a plain page with weak interaction.

avoid: Copy slash commands into a product that does not need blocks
Use gray text with insufficient contrast
Hide important actions until an exact hover target is found
Make every page look like a document when tasks need richer controls

data.agentPrompt: Document-style productivity interface, light gray canvas with a white page, emoji icons, muted text hierarchy, 1px dividers, compact spacing, contextual actions revealed on hover
